semantic_effective_mapping_rule: Compare final effective mappings case-for-case. DIRECT agrees only when both mappings are DIRECT and issuer identity is EXACT or EQUIVALENT under ai-shadow-issuer-semantic-identity-v1. PROXY agrees only when both mappings are PROXY with the same case-normalized bounded proxy exposure. UNRESOLVED agrees only when both mappings are UNRESOLVED.
strict_mapping_rule: Compare final effective mapping class case-for-case; DIRECT issuer strings use the frozen C1F3 strict deterministic canonicalization, PROXY uses the same case-normalized bounded exposure, and UNRESOLVED uses class equality.
typed_attribution_rule: Whole and per-role typed-attribution agreement compare issuer-role sets under ai-shadow-issuer-semantic-identity-v1; whole agreement also requires exact case-normalized principal-proxy-candidate set equality. Every role metric uses all 48 cases, including empty/empty agreement.
attribution_completeness_rule: For each run independently determine semantic completeness against the frozen v3 typed labels, allowing extras but requiring every expected issuer-role and principal-proxy candidate; agreement means the two completeness booleans are equal.
policy_decision_rule: Compare the complete frozen C1E policy decision projection for exact equality, including accepted/abstained state and reasons.
deterministic_resolution_rule: Compare the complete event-asset-resolution-v1 projection for exact equality. Accuracy retention separately gates incorrect deterministic ticker or rule resolutions at zero.
accuracy_context_rule: For every case classify original and repeat semantic mapping correctness against the frozen v3 label as original wrong / repeat correct, original correct / repeat wrong, both wrong same way, both wrong differently, or both correct.
changed_case_rule: List every case failing semantic effective-mapping agreement with original and repeat mappings, issuer/proxy values, identity outcome, typed-role differences, policy projections, resolver projections, and accuracy context.
